$comment: Single source of truth for Northside Christian Church brand data. All asset paths are relative to the repo root. Values come from the Northside Brand Guidelines (2023-11-07) unless a 'source' field says otherwise. Fields marked needs_review have not been confirmed by the Digital Ministry team.

brand.name: Northside Christian Church
brand.architecture: Branded house, not a house of brands. Ministries follow the Northside Christian Church pattern. Kidside, NSM, and Young Adults have their own brand guides.

rules: Use 'Northside Christian Church' on first reference. Never drop 'Christian' on first reference.
'Northside' alone is fine after the first mention.

primary.name: Green NCC
primary.usage: Main brand color. Links, buttons, and key accents.

palette.name: Dark Coral
palette.pantone_note: The guidelines PDF prints 2706 C for Dark Coral, the same value as Light Purple. This looks like a typo in the PDF. Treat as unconfirmed.
palette.text_on_note: White reaches only 3.7:1 on Dark Coral. Use white for large or bold text only.

gradients.note: The guidelines show four gradients (Gradient #1 to #4). They are soft, free-form blends of the brand colors with no fixed color stops, so they are not recorded as values here. See page 20 of the guidelines PDF.

web_neutrals.source: mynorthside.com theme, not the guidelines PDF

semantic.source: mynorthside.com theme, not the guidelines PDF

typography.licensing: Gotham, Dharma Gothic, Helvetica Neue, and Proxima Nova are commercial typefaces. Font files are not included in this repo and must not be added to a public repo.

families.name: Gotham
families.role: Main logo type. Body text, long intertitles, and informational text.
families.css_stack: Gotham, 'Gotham SSm', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.notes: Better suited to web than print.

families.name: Dharma Gothic
families.notes: Expressive and imposing. Needs height to read well. Avoid it where space is tight.

families.name: Helvetica Neue / Helvetica Now
families.role: Complementary type for headlines and on-screen content.
families.notes: Use the extended version with care. It does not work well for long sentences.

web.name: Proxima Nova
web.source: Observed on mynorthside.com (Adobe Fonts). Not listed in the guidelines PDF.
web.needs_review: Confirm whether Proxima Nova is the approved web typeface or a stand-in for Gotham.

rules: Avoid setting long text in all caps or italics. Save them for short titles, subtitles, and key ideas.
Avoid underlines, except for short titles set large.
Set line spacing about 20% larger than the font size (14px text gets 16.8px line spacing).
Do not use full justification, especially on screens.
Left-align text and do not break words with hyphens.
Serif type suits long printed pieces. Sans serif suits screens.

logos.source: Official logo files from the Digital Ministry shared drive (NCC Branding Assets / Logos), converted from the vector PDFs to SVG.

full_logo.description: Logo symbol plus the Northside Christian Church logo type, horizontal. Use this in most contexts.

full_logo_stacked.description: Stacked version of the full logo, for square or narrow spaces.

simple_logo.description: Logo symbol plus the word Northside. For places where the full name is already clear.

logo_mark.description: Logo symbol only (the N in a circle). For avatars, favicons, and tight spaces.

variants.light: White artwork for dark or colored backgrounds.
variants.dark: Dark artwork (#373A36) for white or cream backgrounds.

logos.clearspace: Half the height of the logo on every side. No graphic elements inside this zone.
donts: Do not use the Northside logo type by itself without permission.
Do not change the logo type.
Do not warp, stretch, skew, or slant the logo.
Do not add a stroke to the logo.
Do not add embellishments such as gradients or drop shadows.
Do not place the logo on complex or patterned backgrounds.

sub_brands.rule: We are a branded house. Ministries do not exist apart from Northside, and ministry logos follow the Northside Christian Church pattern unless the ministry has its own brand guide below.
sub_brands.shared: All three sub-brands use Gotham (Book, Medium, Bold, Black) for body text and follow the main photography and video guidance.

kidside.name: Kidside
kidside.source: NCC Kidside Brand Guidelines (2023). The guide spells the name KidSide.

colors.name: Sea Kidside
colors.note: The guide prints FF9703 for this color, which is Yellow NCC. That is a typo. This value was read from the swatch artwork in the guide. Confirm it.

typography.name: Grobold
typography.role: Logo type. A cartoon-inspired face, customized in the logo.

typography.name: Gotham
typography.role: Main type for body text, intertitles, and informational text.

logo_rules.clearspace: Half the height of the logo on every side.
donts: Do not change the logo type.
Do not warp, stretch, skew, or slant the logo.
Do not add a stroke to the logo.
Do not add gradients, drop shadows, or other effects.
Do not place the logo on complex or patterned backgrounds.
Do not use parts of the logo on their own without approval from the Communications Team.

kidside.elements: Kidside color waves: flowing shapes in the brand colors that surround the logo, balance a layout, or hold photos.

donts: Do not change the logo type.

brand_elements.waves: Northside Waves: a line-based graphic used in the corners of a piece to balance it and add rhythm.
brand_elements.noise: Add 12% to 15% noise (uniform distribution, monochrome) to some photos and backgrounds for contrast.
brand_elements.photo_containers: Circular image containers may be used in advertising and internal pieces.
brand_elements.textures: Textured paper, scratches, and torn edges are allowed in moderation. Never at the cost of legibility.
brand_elements.assets: Not included in this repo yet.

shooting: Shoot the crowd more than the stage. Lobby shots are gold.
Capture natural, warm moments. Avoid staged shots.
Frame on the rule of thirds and leave empty space for text.
Show diversity in age, gender, and ethnicity.
Get wide, medium, and tight shots.
Shoot through the crowd, not above it.
Be present without becoming part of the show.
Use a shallow depth of field.
editing: Mildly crush the blacks for depth.
Saturate for richness, not just brightness.
Do not over-process. Avoid trendy looks that date quickly.

voice.source: Northside staff writing standards, not the guidelines PDF
voice.summary: Jesus-centered, simple, and respectful. Write the way a warm, clear staff member would speak, not like a corporate memo.
voice.audience: Assume readers include people who are new to faith.
voice.scripture: Quote from the NIV or NLT and always give the reference. Never guess at a verse's wording.

do: Use the full logo in most contexts.
Use Green NCC as the lead color.
Keep the clear space around the logo.
Write 'Northside Christian Church' on first reference.
dont: Do not create a new logo for a ministry. Use the Northside pattern or an approved sub-brand.
Do not use the logo type without the symbol.
Do not recolor, stretch, outline, or add effects to the logo.
